---
title: "Automated Planning Engine (PDDL)"
subtitle: "Heuristic search planning in the Fast Downward tradition"
---

A planning engine that solves PDDL problems, with A* search and heuristics to keep the search tractable.

[View source on GitHub](https://github.com/laurasalop03/pddl-automated-planning-engine){.btn .btn-outline-secondary}

## What it covers

- **A\* search optimization**: finding optimal plans with an informed search.
- **Heuristic pruning**: using heuristics to avoid exploring hopeless states.
- **State space reduction**: shrinking the problem so it can be solved in reasonable time.

## Why it is relevant to quant work

Heuristic search and state space reasoning are core algorithmic tools. This project demonstrates them end to end on a hard combinatorial problem.

## Tech

PDDL, in the Fast Downward tradition.
